data.summary: Senior Project Manager / Technical Delivery Leader with 15+ years of experience delivering complex technology, software development, cloud transformation and digital banking initiatives across Banking, Payments and FinTech. Experience across Global Transaction Banking (iGTB), Core Banking (iGCB), Payments, Corporate Lending, Cash Management, Treasury and Investment Banking, including ISO 20022-compliant payment solutions and transaction-processing platforms. End-to-end SDLC delivery covering planning, requirements, estimation, resources, Agile delivery, technical design, development, testing, UAT, release management and production support. Strong technical understanding of AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins/CI- CD, REST APIs, Microservices, Kafka, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and reporting/data technologies.

all_skills: Technical & Delivery Management: End-to-End Project Delivery
Architecture & Systems Design: Java / JEE Enterprise Architecture

Candidate's residential location or work city.
Candidate's target headline or most recent job title.
Executive bio, professional overview, or career objective.
Technical programming languages and core software competencies.
Software platforms, developer tools, and operational systems.
Functional domain knowledge (e.g. Hedge Funds, KYC, NAV, Derivatives).
Complete list of candidate skills across all categories.
Complete chronological employment records with bullet points.
University, college, and higher education degree qualifications.
Major projects or strategic initiatives led by candidate.

SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER | TECHNICAL DELIVERY | PAYMENTS & DIGITAL BANKING 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Intellect Design Arena Pvt Ltd | Senior Projects Manager – iGTB & Digital Banking Platforms May 2024 – Present • Provide technical project and delivery leadership across Global Transaction Banking, Digital Banking, Payments and Core Banking platforms, managing governance, delivery outcomes, capacity utilization and client escalations. • Lead payment-processing and transaction-banking initiatives, including ISO 20022-compliant payment messaging, coordinating Engineering, Architecture, QA, DevOps and Business stakeholders. • Own Agile SDLC delivery including Sprint Planning, Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Grooming, using JIRA velocity and burndown metrics.
Nandarajsatish P A | Senior Project Manager / Technical Delivery | Payments & Digital Banking
Lead cloud-native delivery across AWS, Docker and Kubernetes, coordinating deployments, API integrations, environment readiness and releases with DevOps. • Oversee REST API and Kafka-based event-driven integrations supporting financial transactions and banking workflows. • Coordinate requirements, technical design, development, testing, UAT, release and production-support activities. • Manage resources, financial planning/allocation, risks, dependencies and stakeholder governance; support secure integrations using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML and SSO.
Loma Technology, Cambodia | Technical Lead – FinTech / Payment Platform KK Exchange Platform & Tele-bet Systems | Nov 2022 – Mar 2024 • Led technical delivery for FinTech and payment platform initiatives, combining Agile Scrum leadership, software architecture and engineering coordination. • Guided teams developing high-throughput, multi-currency transaction and payment-processing services supporting real-time financial transactions. • Coordinated requirements, development, testing, defect resolution, release and production activities; facilitated Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement and Reviews. • Designed microservices-based payment services and REST APIs for transaction processing and external financial-system integration. • Supported payment validation, transaction-status workflows, CI/CD, Docker-based deployments and environment readiness. • Implemented Prometheus/Grafana observability and coordinated technical dependencies, defects, releases and production issues.
Technology: Java 17 | Spring Boot | Microservices | REST API | MySQL | Hibernate | Docker | Redis | Prometheus | Grafana | Jenkins | JIRA | SonarQube
Orion Innovation Pvt Ltd – Client: Fiserv Inc. | Senior Java API Developer / Technical Lead Consultant Bank Intelligence Platform | July 2021 – Nov 2022 • Supported technical delivery and API architecture for banking financial-investment insights; designed RESTful APIs and microservices. • Collaborated with UI, backend and business teams on requirements, data payloads, integration and performance. • Supported user-story sizing, technical solutioning, automated API testing and UAT; reduced manual UAT cycles by 30%.
Eagle Software India Pvt Ltd – Client: Government of Haryana | Technical Lead Smart City Mission Karnal & eDLVRS | June 2018 – July 2021 • Directed engineering delivery and architecture; managed client communication, Sprint Planning, code reviews and integration milestones. • Led application/database integration, testing, dependencies and SLA-related commitments.
Virtusa Inc. | Associate Consultant / Application Programmers Lead Clients: Bank of Montreal & Credit Suisse | Oct 2013 – May 2017 • Delivered enterprise technology solutions for Commercial Lending and Investment Banking environments. • Implemented Misys Loan IQ configurations supporting syndicated and commercial lending workflows. • Developed Core Java components for financial risk identification, market scenario analysis and automated reporting.
Nandarajsatish P A | Senior Project Manager / Technical Delivery | Payments & Digital Banking
• Coordinated requirements, development, testing and production-release activities; managed build/release across UAT and production and supported stabilization.
KSAB Software | Software Engineer Mar 2010 – Oct 2013 • Developed enterprise web applications using Java/JEE, supporting database programming, defect resolution and unit testing.
KEY CLIENTS / DOMAIN EXPOSURE MBSB Berhad | Dubai Islamic Bank (DIB) | VCB | Citi Bank | Morgan Stanley | Credit Suisse | Bank of Montreal (Loan IQ) Global Transaction Banking | Core Banking | Payments | ISO 20022 | Corporate/Commercial Lending | Investment Banking | Treasury | Cash Management
